Build ps1 files (defunct)

build_ps1_from_xlsx.Rd

Calling this function always fails. It used to generate, from an Excel file of users, the Microsoft Graph PowerShell scripts (New-MgUser/Remove-MgUser) that created and deleted accounts in bulk on Microsoft Entra ID, carrying each user's project authorization in the jobTitle field of the account.

Usage

build_ps1_from_xlsx(...)

Arguments

...

Ignored.

Value

Never returns: it always signals an error.

Details

It is retired because every instance is now linked to the authorization channel, and the jobTitle field is no longer a channel: a script that wrote it would put a second transport back on the same authorization. Accounts and rights are requested through the register, and the channel carries them out.

The function stays exported so that a call from an old script stops with this explanation, instead of failing on a missing function.

Examples

try(build_ps1_from_xlsx())
#> Error in build_ps1_from_xlsx() : 
#>   `build_ps1_from_xlsx()` is defunct. Every instance is now linked to the authorization channel, and the `jobTitle` field is no longer a channel: request accounts and rights through the register of requests.
